text:
Augsburg’s median asking rent sits at 14.09 €/m², up 4.4 % year‑on‑year and 28.1 % over the last five years, placing the city ninth among the 37 most expensive German markets. The 60 m² benchmark apartment costs about 845 € per month, while the rent‑burden for two residents is 19.9 %.

The market remains balanced with a vacancy rate of 2.1 % and 24 days on market; 27 % of listings are let within a week, indicating moderate tightness. Asking rents exceed existing rents by 66 % (8.48 €/m²), highlighting limited affordability.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 14.94 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 14.57 €/m² and 15.32 €/m², a 6 % increase.
